newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Gas pipeline explodes in central Seoul.
newsitem.headline: Gas pipeline explodes in central Seoul.

text.p: An underground gas pipeline exploded in central Seoul on Thursday and residents were being evacuated, state radio said.
There were no immediate reports of casualties, the radio added. A police official confirmed the explosion, but gave no more details.
Korea Broadcasting System said a flame from the explosion reached up to 50 metres (160 feet) before it was brought under control about 30 minutes later.
It said an excavator at a subway construction site hit the gas pipe before the blast.
Police later said there were no casualties from the explosion.
